competency_fulfillment.rationale: This competency asks students to order similar fractions, but its three ordering-formatted samples order whole numbers instead, e.g. seed 44's 'Arrange these numbers from smallest to largest: 502, 507, 506, 495, 493' contains no fractions at all.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Neither ordering direction is ever shown with fraction values; seed 50's ordering item ('497, 505, 510, 498, 501') and its two siblings are all integer sequences, not sets of same-denominator fractions.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The integer-ordering sentences, e.g. seed 45's 'Arrange these numbers from smallest to largest: 505, 498, 492, 503', are readable at grade 2 quarter 4 level even though their content doesn't match the competency.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The nine samples alternate between single similar-fraction naming (seed 43's 3/4, seed 51's 2/4) and whole-number ordering (seeds 44, 45, 50); no sample ever asks the student to sequence multiple fractions by size.

competency_alignment.rationale: The ordering mechanic in seeds 44, 45 and 50 sequences three-digit whole numbers, which builds place-value/number-sense skill, not the fraction-magnitude comparison this competency specifically names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Ordered integers reach 510 (seed 50), far beyond any plausible scale for comparing similar fractions with denominators up to 8, confirming the ordering content was never actually generated for fractions.
